name: jellyfin.avado.dnp.dappnode.eth
title: Jellyfin (films and music)
shortDescription: Your own streaming service for your films, series and music
description: Your own streaming service: Jellyfin plays the films, series, music and home videos you keep on your AVADO, on your TV, phone, tablet or computer, with no subscription and no tracking. Getting started: open Jellyfin, pick your language and create your user name and password (you can skip "Add media library"). Then open "Add films and music" (in this app's links, or https://jellyfin.my.ava.do/avado-upload/), sign in with the same user name and password, choose Films, Series, Music or Home videos and pick the files or folders on your computer: they are copied to your AVADO and appear in Jellyfin a few minutes later. To watch on a TV or phone, install the free Jellyfin app and use the server address https://jellyfin.my.ava.do. Any device that can open my.ava.do (at home on the AVADO network, or away through Remote Access) can watch. Converting a video for a phone or a slow connection uses a lot of processor time; your AVADO gives the Ethereum node priority, so playback may pause briefly while the node is busy.
author: AVADO
